entry.title: Version 10.1.0
entry.content:
New features​

  • Docs API:
    • Added an FAQ entry on reading form field values from a document that is open in the editor.
  • Samples:
    • Search now covers every Docs, DocSpace and AI sample, whatever category is selected.
    • Added a clear button to the samples search.
  • ONLYOFFICE Apps:
    • Added the Chat, Personal, Public room and Forms mode pages to the Embed SDK.
    • Added the Customization (locale, theming, UI elements) and Events and callbacks sections to the Embed SDK.
    • Documented OAuth authentication in the Embed SDK, including token refresh, session guards and sign-out.
    • Documented custom actions and the expanded Manager mode methods in the Embed SDK.
    • Added the Embed SDK changelog page.

Improvements​

  • Docs API:
    • Documented the wopi.requireIpFilterRule setting and the explicit IP filter rule that the WOPI host requires from 10.0.
    • Listed the WOPI request checks that always apply and explained how the Request Filtering Agent lists interact with the IP filter.
  • ONLYOFFICE Apps:
    • Renamed DocSpace to ONLYOFFICE Apps in site labels, page copy, samples, SDK pages and code comments.
    • Updated the API backend get-started screenshots and texts for v4.0.0, including the API keys, OAuth 2.0 and Developer Tools menu paths.
    • Clarified which OAuth app settings can be changed after creation.
    • Synced the MCP server docs with the docspace-mcp repository, refreshed the quickstart screenshots and described the tool confirmation dialog.
    • Polished the MCP server getting started, tutorials and troubleshooting pages.
    • Moved Troubleshooting & FAQ into More information in the Embed SDK.
    • Linked the Desktop Editors MCP setup steps from the MCP server clients page instead of duplicating them.
    • Showed the build script in its package.json context in the Plugins SDK migration guide.
    • Used plugin package names as shown in the plugins list on the Plugins SDK sample pages.
  • AI:
    • Renamed the AI tab to AI Tools across the AI guides.
    • Clarified the setup steps on the server-wide AI providers page.
    • Removed the custom AI tools guide, the AI tools quick start and the AI tool samples, as AI Tools no longer supports adding custom tools.
    • Rewrote the AI overview around setting up and using AI Tools.
    • Documented the current custom provider file format, based on the template from the editor.
  • Desktop:
    • Updated screenshots and UI steps for 10.0.
    • Renamed the MCP chat to AI Chat, clarified the MCP version history and noted which setup steps predate 10.0.
    • Dropped DocSpace from the placeholder URL in the MCP server samples.
  • Localization:
    • Replaced 协作空间 with ONLYOFFICE Apps and spaced product names, Latin text and numbers from adjacent Chinese text.
    • Switched zh-CN pages to full-width quotes, brackets and —— dashes, ： between terms and descriptions, and 、 between list items.
    • Translated remaining English UI labels, menu names and image alt text in plugin samples, MCP and AI guides, and the WOPI overview.

Bugfixes​

  • Fixed the WOPI IP filter example address not matching the step that describes it.
  • Fixed inaccuracies in the Embed SDK authentication, events, customization and forms pages.
  • Fixed broken API doc links and switched to case-sensitive APITable anchors in the Embed SDK.
  • Fixed installation anchors in the MCP server use cases and removed leftover generator markers.
  • Fixed spacing around bold text next to Chinese characters in zh-CN pages.

entry.title: Version 10.0.0
entry.content:
New features​

  • Docs API:
    • Added the Comparing documents sample.
    • Added the File upload request page for /converter/from-file and documented /docbuilder/from-file.
    • Documented the customization.ai parameter.
    • Added the Configuring AI providers for all users guide for the Admin Panel.
    • Documented the interactivepreview WOPI discovery action.
    • Documented the requestRoles method, the disconnect parameter of startFilling and the sendEvent method of the Connector class.
    • Added the ofd format and xls as a spreadsheet conversion target.
    • Added the 10.0 changelog covering server, Admin Panel and API changes.
  • Office API:
    • Added the 10.0 changelog with breaking changes, changed methods, and new methods and classes.
  • Plugins and macros:
    • Documented the Editor object for calling editor methods and Editor.RunMacro as the replacement for callCommand.
    • Added the 10.0 changelog.
  • Desktop:
    • Documented the --prefer-alternate-url flag and added the 10.0 changelog.
  • Document Builder:
    • Documented opening PDF files in OpenFile and creating PDF forms with the form file type in CreateFile, and added the 10.0 changelog.
  • DocSpace:
    • Added the UI Kit section to the DocSpace menu and landing page.

Improvements​

  • Docs API:
    • Documented the operation field in incoming and outgoing request tokens and purposeCheck for incoming ones.
    • Documented the convertServiceEnable and docbuilderEnable settings and the WOPI IP filter requirement.
    • Documented the purposeCheck and wopi.requireIpFilterRule settings and the new default User-Agent of outgoing requests in the 10.0 changelog.
    • Rewrote the integration examples overview and the Node.js, Go, Java, Java Spring, .NET, PHP, PHP Laravel, Python and Ruby examples.
    • Formatted parameters, status values and identifiers as inline code in the FAQ and the changelog.
    • Added ellipsis comments to partial config examples in the FAQ.
  • Office API:
    • Updated the Document, Spreadsheet, Presentation, PDF and Form API references for 10.0.
    • Linked the PDF API overview classes.
  • Plugins and macros:
    • Updated the plugin API references for 10.0.
    • Described the executeMethod signature and callback in How to call methods.
  • AI:
    • Reordered the AI guides sidebar so the setup pages come first.
  • DocSpace:
    • Built the API backend reference from DocSpace-server instead of the OpenAPI spec.
    • Updated the API backend, JavaScript SDK, Plugins SDK and UI Kit references.
  • Common:
    • Gave each deployment target its own site URL.
  • Playground:
    • Updated the plugin template to use the built-in Editor object.
  • Localization:
    • Synced the zh-CN pages with all of the above changes.
    • Kept the per-editor API names (Document API, Form API and others) in English on zh-CN pages.
    • Translated the missing customizing FAQ sections and the 9.3 section of the plugins changelog.

Bugfixes​

  • Fixed serverVersion in refreshHistory and the callback handler sample to be a version string rather than a number.
  • Fixed the ipfilter example to nest under services.CoAuthoring.
  • Fixed Office API changelog links to renamed and removed methods.
  • Fixed the form widgets listed in the PDF API overview.
  • Fixed DocSpace API backend links to point at the generated pages.
  • Fixed the AI service reference to point at aichat.
  • Fixed the UI Kit sidebar to open on its first generated page.
  • Fixed the form builder sample in the Playground to create and save a PDF form.
  • Fixed the PDF builder sample in the Playground to open a PDF file.
  • Fixed the upload/download direction, the "Access denied" heading and the formatting on the troubleshooting page.
  • Fixed the fillForms typo in the sharing FAQ.
  • Fixed full-width punctuation and spacing on zh-CN pages and in the zh-CN announcement bar.

Breaking changes​

  • Docs API:
    • Removed the deprecated reviewDisplay, showReviewChanges and trackChanges customization parameters.
